theorem putnam_1964_b2
(S : Type*) [Fintype S] [Nonempty S]
(P : Finset (Set S))
(hPP : ∀ T ∈ P, ∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅)
(hPS : ¬∃ T : Set S, T ∉ P ∧ (∀ U ∈ P, T ∩ U ≠ ∅))
: (P.card = 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1)) := by
  have h_subset_or_compl : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := by
    intro A
    by_contra! h
    exact hPS ⟨Aᶜ, h.2, fun U hU => by
      have := hPP U hU Aᶜ h.2
      simp [Set.inter_compl_self] at this⟩
  
  have h_not_both : ∀ (A : Set S), A ∈ P → Aᶜ ∉ P := by
    intro A hA hAc
    have : A ∩ Aᶜ = ∅ := by simp [Set.inter_compl_self]
    exact (hPP A hA Aᶜ hAc).elim this
  
  classical
  let Q : Finset (Set S) := Finset.univ \ P
  
  have h₁ : P.card = Q.card := by
    apply Finset.card_bij' (fun A _ => Aᶜ) (fun A _ => Aᶜ)
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_univ, true_and]
      exact h_not_both A hA
    · intro A hA
      simp only [Set.mem_diff, Set.mem_univ, true_and] at hA
      have : A ∈ P ∨ Aᶜ ∈ P := h_subset_or_compl A
      cases this with
      | inl h => exact h
      | inr h => exact (h_not_both Aᶜ h (by simp [Set.compl_compl])).elim hA
    · intro A hA
      simp [Set.compl_compl]
    · intro A hA
      simp [Set.compl_compl]
  
  have h₂ : P.card + Q.card = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    have : P.card + Q.card = (Finset.univ : Finset (Set S)).card := by
      rw [← Finset.card_union_of_disjoint, Finset.union_diff_cancel]
      · exact Finset.disjoint_iff.mpr (fun x hx₁ hx₂ => (hx₂.2 hx₁).elim)
      · exact Finset.subset_univ P
    rw [this, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_set]
  
  have h₃ : Fintype.card S ≥ 1 := by
    have : 0 < Fintype.card S := by positivity
    omega
  
  have h₄ : 2 ^ (Fintype.card S - 1) * 2 = 2 ^ Fintype.card S := by
    rw [← pow_add, Nat.sub_add_cancel h₃]
    simp
  
  omega
